segments.text: Day three of 100 Days of Machine Learning: your first ML project, the real way.
segments.caption: Day 3 of 100 Days of Machine Learning: your first ML project, the real way.

segments.text: Eight steps, and the real problems data scientists face at every one. Save this one!
segments.caption: 8 steps, and the real problems data scientists face at every one. Save this one!

segments.text: Courses give you clean data and a happy ending. Real projects don't.
segments.caption: Courses give you clean data and a happy ending. Real projects don't.

segments.text: Let's follow one real project, predicting flat prices in Bangalore, and see what actually goes wrong.
segments.caption: Let's follow one real project, predicting flat prices in Bangalore, and see what actually goes wrong.

segments.text: Step one, problem definition. Your manager says: predict flat prices. That's it.
segments.caption: Step 1, problem definition. Your manager says: predict flat prices. That's it.

segments.text: The real problem: a vague ask. Prices for whom? Buyers, sellers, or a bank? And how accurate is good enough?
segments.caption: The real problem: a vague ask. Prices for whom? Buyers, sellers, or a bank? And how accurate is good enough?

segments.text: So you ask questions first, and agree on success: say, within eight lakh.
segments.caption: So you ask questions first, and agree on success: say, within 8 lakh.

segments.text: Step two, data collection. The data you need is never in one place.
segments.caption: Step 2, data collection. The data you need is never in one place.

segments.text: Listings sit on different websites. Half have no price. And most are asking prices, not what flats actually sold for.
segments.caption: Listings sit on different websites. Half have no price. And most are asking prices, not what flats actually sold for.

segments.text: So you combine sources, and note what each one really measures.
segments.caption: So you combine sources, and note what each one really measures.

segments.text: Step three, data cleaning. This is where most of your time goes.
segments.caption: Step 3, data cleaning. This is where most of your time goes.

segments.text: Two BHK, 2bhk and two bedroom, all meaning the same thing. Area in square feet and square metres. And the same flat, posted by three different brokers.
segments.caption: "2 BHK", "2bhk" and "two bedroom", all meaning the same thing. Area in sq ft and sq m. And the same flat, posted by 3 different brokers.

segments.text: You standardise everything, remove duplicates, and flag anything suspicious.
segments.caption: You standardise everything, remove duplicates, and flag anything suspicious.

segments.text: Step four, exploratory data analysis. You plot everything, and find surprises.
segments.caption: Step 4, exploratory data analysis. You plot everything, and find surprises.

segments.text: Prices near one new metro station jumped thirty percent in a year. Is that real, or a data error?
segments.caption: Prices near one new metro station jumped 30% in a year. Is that real, or a data error?

segments.text: So you check with people who know the market before trusting a pattern.
segments.caption: So you check with people who know the market before trusting a pattern.

segments.text: Step five, the train test split. The trap: mixing old and new sales together.
segments.caption: Step 5, the train-test split. The trap: mixing old and new sales together.

segments.text: Prices keep rising, so you test on the most recent months, exactly how the model will be used.
segments.caption: Prices keep rising, so you test on the most recent months, exactly how the model will be used.

segments.text: Step six, model training. The model scores amazingly well. Too well.
segments.caption: Step 6, model training. The model scores amazingly well. Too well.

segments.text: It was using days on market, which you only know after the flat sells. That's called data leakage. Remove it, and you get an honest score.
segments.caption: It was using days on market, which you only know after the flat sells. That's called data leakage. Remove it, and you get an honest score.

segments.text: Step seven, model evaluation. The average error looks fine.
segments.caption: Step 7, model evaluation. The average error looks fine.

segments.text: But for luxury villas and brand new areas, it's way off. So you check accuracy group by group, not just the overall number.
segments.caption: But for luxury villas and brand new areas, it's way off. So you check accuracy group by group, not just the overall number.

segments.text: Step eight, deployment. The model goes live. Six months later, interest rates change, and predictions slowly go wrong.
segments.caption: Step 8, deployment. The model goes live. 6 months later, interest rates change, and predictions slowly go wrong.

segments.text: That's model drift. So you monitor it, and retrain regularly.
segments.caption: That's model drift. So you monitor it, and retrain regularly.

segments.text: So here's the real checklist.
segments.caption: So here's the real checklist.

segments.text: Ask before you build. Know your sources. Clean everything. Question every pattern. Test on recent data. Watch for leakage. Check every group. Monitor after launch.
segments.caption: Ask before you build. Know your sources. Clean everything. Question every pattern. Test on recent data. Watch for leakage. Check every group. Monitor after launch.
